Description

Links are NOT allowed. Format your description nicely so people can easily read them. Please use proper spacing and paragraphs.

Chen Zhuo transmigrated into a world where urban power-fantasy novels had fused together, becoming a minor villain. He possessed a wish-granting system that allowed him to make one wish every day.

What he never expected was that this shady, trickster-like system would set him up—any wish he made would be granted to his enemies at double, or even ten times the effect!

Left with no other choice, Chen Zhuo could only rely on outrageous, unconventional tactics, stepping onto a path no ordinary person would have ever imagined.

“I wish to be surrounded by 20-year-old girls!”

The first protagonist ended up surrounded by a group of 60-year-old aunties, bursting into tears!

“I wish for my weight to increase to 85 kilograms!”

The second protagonist’s weight skyrocketed to 510 kilograms, completely shattering his mental state!

“I wish for my heart rate to stay at 75 beats per minute!”

The third protagonist’s heart rate went haywire at 750 beats per minute—dead!

“…”
